Coram : SUDHANSHU DHULIA*, PRASANNA BHALACHANDRA VARALE
Issue for Consideration (1) Whether respondent-purchasers were unaware of lis-pendens and could claim to be bona-fide purchasers and be entitled to protection u/s.41 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882; (2) Whether the principle of lis-pendens as enshrined u/s.52 would apply Punjab; and (3) When would the doctrine of lis-pendens take effect. Headnotes† Transfer of Property Act, 1882 – ss.52 and 41 – Transaction hit by lis pendens – Agreement to sell property between Appellant and Respondent No.3-owner – Appellant paid earnest money
Decision Date : 03-05-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2991/2024 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
